description: Build the complete React frontend. The client skeleton exists (Vite, Bootstrap, axios, react-router-dom all installed; api.js and main.jsx already correct) but App.jsx is still the Vite default and no pages or components exist. This FEAT creates all 8 frontend files. Each file must pass 'cd client && npm run build' before moving to the next. Independent of FEAT-001 (no shared files).
steps: 1. Replace client/src/App.jsx with full React Router v6 application. Import BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate from 'react-router-dom'. Create a ProtectedRoute component: reads localStorage.getItem('token'), if absent returns <Navigate to='/login' replace />, otherwise returns <Outlet /> (import Outlet from react-router-dom). Routes: '/' → ProtectedRoute wrapping Dashboard, '/requests/new' → ProtectedRoute wrapping Dashboard (pass prop newRequest=true or use URL state), '/requests/:id' → ProtectedRoute wrapping RequestDetails, '/login' → Login. Wrap all in BrowserRouter. Remove the Vite default imports (reactLogo, viteLogo, App.css). Verify: cd client && npm run build.

2. Create client/src/components/Navbar.jsx. Bootstrap navbar:
. Left: brand link 'Client Request Desk'. Right: show user name from JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user') || '{}').name. A 'New Request' button (Bootstrap btn-outline-light btn-sm) that uses useNavigate to go to '/requests/new'. A 'Logout' button (btn-outline-danger btn-sm ms-2) that calls localStorage.clear() then navigates to '/login'. Import useNavigate from 'react-router-dom'. Verify: cd client && npm run build.

3. Create client/src/components/RequestList.jsx. Props: requests (array), loading (boolean). When loading=true, show a centered Bootstrap spinner (
). When requests is empty (and not loading), show

No requests found.

. Otherwise render a Bootstrap table (table table-hover table-bordered): columns: Customer, Service, Scheduled Date, Status, Work Item, Actions. Status rendered as . Work Item column: show '✓' if has_work_item > 0. Actions column: View. Import Link from 'react-router-dom'. Verify: cd client && npm run build.

4. Create client/src/components/ConfirmationModal.jsx. Props: show (boolean), request (object), onConfirm (function), onCancel (function), loading (boolean). CRITICAL: this component makes NO API calls. Render a Bootstrap modal overlay. Control visibility: when show=false render null (return null). When show=true render: a modal backdrop div (position:fixed, top:0, left:0, width:'100%', height:'100%', backgroundColor:'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)', zIndex:1040) and a modal dialog div (position:fixed, centered with top:'50%', left:'50%', transform:'translate(-50%,-50%)', zIndex:1050, backgroundColor:'white', borderRadius:'8px', padding:'24px', minWidth:'400px'). Inside: title 'Convert to Work Item', then a summary showing request.customer_name, request.requested_service, request.scheduled_date. Footer: Cancel button (btn btn-secondary, onClick=onCancel) and 'Create Work Item' button (btn btn-success, onClick=onConfirm, disabled=loading). Verify: cd client && npm run build.

5. Create client/src/components/RequestForm.jsx. Props: onSuccess (optional callback). Local state: formData object with fields customer_name, customer_email, requested_service, description, scheduled_date, status (default 'NEW'). Local state: loading boolean, error string. handleSubmit: call api.post('/requests', formData), on success call onSuccess(result.data) if provided. Render a Bootstrap form. Each field is a form-group with label and input/select/textarea. Status is a <select> with options NEW, QUALIFIED, CLOSED. Submit button shows 'Creating...' when loading. Show error in a Bootstrap alert-danger div. Import api from '../api'. Verify: cd client && npm run build.

6. Create client/src/pages/Login.jsx. Centers a Bootstrap card on the page using d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center min-vh-100. Card contains: heading 'Client Request Desk', login form (email input, password input, submit button). Local state: email, password, loading, error. handleSubmit: call api.post('/auth/login', {email, password}), on success store token and user in localStorage ('token', 'user' as JSON string), navigate to '/'. On error show message in alert-danger. Below the form, show a Bootstrap alert-info with demo credentials for both workspaces: Workspace A: usera@example.com / Password123!, Workspace B: userb@example.com / Password123!. Import useNavigate from 'react-router-dom', api from '../api'. Verify: cd client && npm run build.

7. Create client/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx. Uses Navbar, RequestList, RequestForm, ConfirmationModal (ConfirmationModal not needed here, skip). Local state: requests (array), loading, statusFilter ('' = All), showForm (boolean). useEffect: call api.get('/requests' + (statusFilter ? '?status='+statusFilter : '')) on mount and when statusFilter changes. Render: <Navbar />, then a container div. Heading row: 'Requests' h2, and a btn-group with buttons All/NEW/QUALIFIED/CLOSED (active class when selected). Below: if showForm, render <RequestForm onSuccess={(r)=>{ setShowForm(false); fetchRequests(); }} />. Below: <RequestList requests={requests} loading={loading} />. The 'New Request' button in Navbar navigates to '/requests/new'. Handle that route by reading useLocation or a prop: if the path is '/requests/new', set showForm=true on mount (use useEffect with location). Use useLocation and useNavigate from react-router-dom. Import api from '../api'. Verify: cd client && npm run build.

8. Create client/src/pages/RequestDetails.jsx. Uses Navbar, ConfirmationModal. On mount: call api.get('/requests/'+id) — this returns {request fields, activities:[], work_item: obj|null}. Local state: request (object|null), loading, error, updating (for status PATCH), showModal (boolean), converting (boolean). Render: <Navbar />, then a container. Top section: two Bootstrap cards side-by-side (row + col-md-6) — Customer Info (name, email) and Request Info (service, description, scheduled_date, status). Status shows the badge AND a <select> to change status inline; on change call api.patch('/requests/'+id, {status}) then refresh. Work Item section: if request.work_item exists, show a Bootstrap card with the work item details (title, created_at, created_by_name). If request.status==='QUALIFIED' and !request.work_item, show a 'Convert to Work Item' btn-warning button that sets showModal=true. Activities section: heading 'Activity Timeline', map activities into .timeline-item divs showing activity_type, message, user_name, created_at (format as readable date). Render <ConfirmationModal show={showModal} request={request} onCancel={()=>setShowModal(false)} onConfirm={handleConvert} loading={converting} />. handleConvert: set converting=true, call api.post('/requests/'+id+'/convert'), on success refresh request data, setShowModal(false), setConverting(false). On error show error message. Use useParams for id, api from '../api'. Verify: cd client && npm run build.
acceptance_criteria: cd client && npm run build exits with code 0 (all imports resolve, no syntax errors)
App.jsx uses React Router v6 with ProtectedRoute that redirects unauthenticated users to /login
ConfirmationModal makes no API calls — it only calls onConfirm callback when button is clicked
Dashboard shows filter buttons and calls api.get('/requests?status=X') when a filter is selected
RequestDetails calls api.post('/requests/:id/convert') only after user clicks 'Create Work Item' in the modal (not when modal opens)
Login page shows demo credentials for both workspaces
verification: cd client && npm run build   (run from worktree root, i.e. 'cd c:\Users\Lenovo\OneDrive\Desktop\client-request-desk\client-request-desk\client && npm run build' — must exit 0)
findings: build passes (exit 0), all 8 files created: App.jsx (ProtectedRoute + React Router v6), Navbar.jsx, RequestList.jsx, ConfirmationModal.jsx (no API calls), RequestForm.jsx, Login.jsx (demo credentials shown), Dashboard.jsx (filter buttons), RequestDetails.jsx (convert flow)
